before.name: The Evitable Conflict
before.description:
The Machines coordinate the world's economy and protect its overall stability. Their decisions can quietly remove opponents from influential positions, leaving human officials with much less control than their titles suggest. That puts this society near the autonomous-machine end of the control axis, with a broadly protective material orientation. It is a useful analogue for the article's fifth regime.

The zero-variant label records that plant workers, layoffs and actual labor needs persist under machine coordination. Economic management is not automatically release from employment. The best-guess nonworking fraction is therefore modest, allowing dependents and displaced people while retaining useful factory, care and administrative work. It is not derived from the number of governing Machines or one local disturbance. The source-based control point remains near autonomous machine authority, whereas the favorable guarantee estimate describes a protective orientation rather than an explicit unconditional benefit. These are provisional reference-led judgments, with no new full-story reading or canonical census claimed.

before.name: Detroit: Become Human (before the android revolution)
before.society: United States before the android revolution
before.description:
Android service work has displaced a substantial part of the human workforce, while the machines are still treated as property. The result is an uneven transition: automation is widespread, but human society has not adopted an equally widespread entitlement to its output. The guarantee score therefore leans toward weak protection, with uncertainty about policies the consulted material does not describe.

Human owners and institutions still direct android labor, placing control near concentrated ownership with some dispersed private access. The best-guess nonworking fraction is substantial, reflecting displacement while allowing useful unpaid care, informal work and ordinary human careers. The game’s reported unemployment figure is not copied as an all-population participation percentage: children, nonparticipants and unpaid workers change both numerator and denominator. The estimate therefore has a wide interval. This is the society before liberation, and it does not import a later branch’s projected android rights or guarantee that displaced humans receive an adequate material floor.

before.name: Fallout (prewar Appalachia)
before.description:
Hornwright's records show a corporate drive to remove human labor from mining and expand automation further. Machines such as the Motherlode give this more substance than a general claim that the future has robots. The owners aim to preserve output while reducing their dependence on workers, and opposition to that policy is treated as an obstacle to corporate and political plans.

Corporate owners direct the mining machinery, placing control near concentrated human command. The best-guess nonworking fraction is substantial because displacement is real, but it retains repair, care, remaining industrial activity and informal survival as useful work. A company’s staffing target cannot be converted directly into the share of all Appalachian people working. The broad interval includes uncertainty about dependents and the ability to find other work. Weak guarantees mean losing a wage can mean hardship even while productive output continues. The record stops before nuclear destruction, and neither later corpses nor empty automated sites become a population enjoying leisure.

before.name: The Algebraist (Mercatoria)

scope.continuity: The Algebraist; not the Culture setting
scope.period: Mercatorial order before the novel's ending changes its strategic position
scope.population: Human and other biological inhabitants of the Mercatoria
exclusions: All imperial worlds assumed economically identical

before.description:
The Mercatoria's persecution of machine intelligence makes it a zero variant with a direct technological basis. Capable AIs exist in the setting, but the imperial order seeks to prevent their open existence and authority. Production and government therefore cannot simply be described as an independent machine welfare system. The control placement remains near a concentrated biological hierarchy.

The guarantee best guess is weak because an imperial order with unequal ranks does not imply a common material floor, though exact local rights remain unknown. Concentrated biological institutions retain authority while suppressing machine intelligence. A modest nonworking estimate allows dependents and some elite leisure but keeps useful production, administration, care and military activity in the count. It is not derived from the number of capable AIs being persecuted or from a war passage. This zero variant is a technical-restraint comparison across a broad biological proxy population, with wide intervals rather than a claim that every subject world shares an identical employment or benefit policy.

guarantees.basis: An imperial hierarchy suppressing machine intelligence plausibly provides weak universal protection, with unknown differences between ranks and worlds.

control.basis: The biological hierarchy persecutes rather than enfranchises autonomous AIs.

nonworking.basis: All-age biological-population scenario retains administrative, productive, military and care work; no machine-war count is used as a civilian labor rate.

evidence.locator: Machine War explanation; Martin pages 186 and 193
